pages.text: Nine nights Odin hung on the World Tree and won the runes. A carved runestone and the sign of a rune make two runes.
The signs: Fehu - gold, Uruz - leather, Thurisaz - a frost heart, Ansuz - a raven feather, Raidho - a rabbit's foot, Algiz - a shield.
Speak a rune (right-click) and its power is yours for 3 minutes; the stone crumbles. Fehu - luck, Uruz - strength and health, Thurisaz - whoever strikes you is pricked.
Ansuz - night vision, and every creature around is shown. Raidho - speed and leaps, Algiz - resistance and absorption. The runes rest a minute after each one.
Find them in rune circles and valkyrie halls; the volva sells Ansuz and Algiz.
